behavior: AC1: Profile runtime settings survive persistence and existing update paths.
AC2: Profile-only runtime resolution and one-time configuration preserve precedence and credentials.
AC3: Profile ownership rejects duplicates, isolates profiles, and releases on process exit.
AC4: OpenSSH startup failures include actionable client and authentication diagnostics.
AC5: A TLS-valid, unauthenticated real Gitea health probe returns status=pass; live duplicate/isolation observations are additionally required in verification.md.
verification: powershell -NoProfile -Command "if (-not [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('TS_BRIDGE_PROBE_ORIGIN') -or -not [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('TS_BRIDGE_PROBE_LOCAL')) { throw 'Set non-secret probe origin hostname and local address' }; if ((curl.exe --noproxy '*' --fail --connect-timeout 5 --max-time 15 --connect-to ([Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('TS_BRIDGE_PROBE_ORIGIN') + ':443:' + [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('TS_BRIDGE_PROBE_LOCAL')) ('https://' + [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('TS_BRIDGE_PROBE_ORIGIN') + '/api/healthz') | ConvertFrom-Json).status -ne 'pass') { throw 'Gitea health probe did not return status=pass' }"
